written: 2026-11-09, after B6's code (11a59a8) and before its diagnostics existed
about: B6 (research/value-scale-plan.md, Deploy assembly): the Space that deploy/huggingface/build_space.py stages in deploy/huggingface/space, the folder the service is deployed from (deploy/huggingface/PUBLISH.md), run on its own and compared with this repository's service. B6's code: space_manifest.json's uncommitted_changes covers valuescale/, an import check runs on the staged folder, and the reply's value_scale.zeros_read is set only when the table holds a 0 (the owner, 2026-11-09). The predictions come from B5's report (research/notebook-outputs/value_scale_b5/report.json) and a scratch probe of the bank's inputs on 2026-11-09: each table's upload size, and whether its traced table holds an observed 0. No reply was computed for it. Not edited after the run: a row that differs is reported and explained in notes.md.
tables: the bank's 37 tables (valuescale/corpus/bank.json): the 30 that Phase A traced (traced_table: validation passed, at most 2,000 cells drawn with D3's seed), and the 7 that validation refuses (fewer than 20 cells)
how: each side runs in its own fresh interpreter (python -I -B), with the hosted settings (the ENV lines of deploy/huggingface/Dockerfile, as deploy/huggingface/rehearse.py hosted_env reads them; every other VIVOME_ setting removed). The staged Space has only deploy/huggingface/space on its path, and the repository's service only the repository root. One side runs at a time.
B6_build: build_space.py, run by the step from a clean tree, exits 0. Its import check imports 31 modules (service/: 22, valuescale/: 9) from the staged folder alone. space_manifest.json names the commit the step ran at, with uncommitted_changes false and pipeline_version v4.1. Every staged file under service/ and valuescale/ is byte-identical to the repository's. The staged valuescale/ holds its 9 modules and calibration/protein-v1.json, and nothing else: no tests, corpus or bank.
B6_isolated: in every child, service and valuescale are imported from that child's own root: the Space's from deploy/huggingface/space, the repository's from the repository root
B6_pipeline: pipeline.run_projection (v4.1) on each of the 30 traced tables, as protein with nothing stated and as RNA: the Space's reply is byte-identical (canonical JSON) to the repository's, 60 of 60. On the 7 small tables, validation's error is identical, 7 of 7.
B6_status: GET /api/status: the Space's reply equals the repository's: status ready, pipeline_version v4.1, limits max_cells 2000, max_upload_mb 31.0 and concurrent_projections 1, the value_scale choices auto, linear and log, and the zeros choices auto, missing and measured

B6_app.what: each bank file whose upload fits the hosted 31 MiB, sent as the site sends a file whose reading the uploader does not know (modality prot with no value_scale, and modality rna), to the Space's server and to the repository's: status and body identical
B6_app.sent: 33 files: the 26 traced tables whose upload fits (as its file, or as a 2,000-cell subsample the way b5_through_the_app sends one), and the 7 small tables
B6_app.left_to_B6_pipeline: 4 uploads are over 31 MiB: dusszachniewicz_maxquant (90.2 MiB), scope2_export (53.2), khoury_column_normalized (44.4), and furtwangler_log2_imputed's 2,000-cell subsample (61.0). Both servers refuse such an upload for its size before reading it, and B6_status shows the limit is the same on both
B6_app.predicted: 66 of 66 identical: the 26 tables 200 under both modalities, the 7 small tables 400 (fewer than 20 cells)
B6_app.cases: pbmc240_diann with 2 observed values made negative: with nothing stated, 400 with alignment.UNDECIDED_NEGATIVES_REASON; with value_scale linear, 400 with app.STATED_LINEAR_REASON; with value_scale log, 200; with value_scale log and zeros measured, 200.
